data.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION (cycles-exhausted resolution): CANCEL cycle-2 'silent-drop' interpretation of gating_off (was wrong — contradicted dd-6). Authoritative gating semantics per dd-6: gating_off (DSO_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING falsy/unset) + status field touch → StatusMappingError raised, zero side-effects. gating_on (=1) + status field touch → call _route_status_via_draft5 stub (NotImplementedError). gating_on + status NOT in status_map → StatusMappingError raised. Promote 3 explicit AC verify lines (replacing the cycle-2 comment-only references): (a) pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_outbound_update.py::test_status_gating_off_raises_no_side_effects [Mutation with status field + gating off → StatusMappingError, client.update_issue not called]; (b) pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_outbound_update.py::test_status_gating_on_delegates_to_draft5_stub [Mutation with status + gating on → _route_status_via_draft5 invoked]; (c) pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_outbound_update.py::test_status_mapping_error_for_unmapped_status [gating on + status value not in map → StatusMappingError].
